title: Half Marathon Races in Indonesia: 2026-2027 Calendar
intro: Twenty-four half marathons spread from the volcanic crater trails of Banyuwangi's Ijen Geopark Run to the reef-fringed roads of Belitung and the beach town of Senggigi on Lombok, with Java hosting the bulk of the action across Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Yogyakarta, and Kota Batu. September and October are the busiest stretch, carrying 15 of the 24 races between them, including the Garmin Run Asia Series in BSD City and the Locomotive Half Marathon in Bandar Lampung. Most events pair the 21.1km distance with 10km and 5km options, though a few, like Bayan Run in Balikpapan and Banka Run Fest in Belitung, add shorter 2.5km or 0.8km fun runs, and Carabao Half Marathon in Kota Batu goes the other direction with a full marathon on the same day. Beyond the September-October rush, smaller windows open in January, March, April, and May for races like Ciletuh Geopark Run and Belitong Geopark Run.

faqs.question: When is the busiest season for half marathons in Indonesia?
faqs.answer: September and October carry the most events, with seven races in September and eight in October, including Amartha 10X Run in Jakarta, Garmin Run Asia Series in BSD City, and 910 Race in Tangerang. Outside that window, options thin out to one or two races per month through early 2027.

faqs.question: Are there half marathons paired with a full marathon distance?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Carabao Half Marathon in Kota Batu, Jawa Timur, offers a full marathon (42km) alongside the 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances on the same event day, scheduled for March 2027.

faqs.question: What kinds of settings do these half marathons run through?
faqs.answer: The list ranges from island and coastal races like Belitong Geopark Run and Banka Run Fest in Bangka Belitung, and Senggigi's beachfront course on Lombok, to city-centre events in Jakarta and Surabaya, plus geopark routes through Banyuwangi's Ijen and Sukabumi's Ciletuh.

editorial_pick: The Maybank Marathon (84/100) in Gianyar, Bali leads this list -- Indonesia's only World Athletics Elite Label race and a Boston Marathon qualifier, with the 21.1km option riding along a 4:30am start through rice paddies and Balinese villages.
